title: Back to Louisville, then the Cotton Club in Cincinnati with Al Sears's band
summary: Homesick after Albany, she went home and then took a job at the Cotton Club in a Cincinnati hotel. Her band there was Al Sears's, whom she knew from Buffalo, with pianist Bugs Roberts from Kentucky.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: But from Albany you went back home.

Yes, I guess. And so I went back on home and as soon as I got home I had to call the man that owned the Club in Cincinnati and he wanted me to come up and let him hear me. So my mother, father and I, we drove up one Sunday. And it turned out the man had me.
What was the name of that?
It was called the Cotton Club. They had a hotel there in Cincinnati. I can't recall the hotel off hand.
But that was the night club in it?
Yeah, there was a night club in the
